अलवर में अगले 2 दिन बारिश की संभावना:तापमान 17 डिग्री तक गिरेगा,रात में ठंड बढ़ने के आसार; जानिए इस सप्ताह कैसा रहेगा मौसम
- कॉपी लिंक
मौसम विभाग के पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार अलवर में अगले 2 दिन बारिश की संभावना है, जिसके चलते तापमान में गिरावट आएगी और ठंड बढ़ने के आसार हैं।
विभाग ने 29 और 30 अक्टूबर को गरज-चमक के साथ बारिश की संभावना जताई है। इस दौरान बिजली चमकने को लेकर भी चेतावनी जारी की गई है।
मौसम विभाग के अनुसार, 28 अक्टूबर को अधिकतम तापमान 28 डिग्री और न्यूनतम तापमान 18 डिग्री रहने का अनुमान है। वहीं, 29 और 30 अक्टूबर को अधिकतम तापमान 27 डिग्री और न्यूनतम तापमान 17 डिग्री तक रह सकता है। इससे दिन के तापमान में गिरावट आने और सुबह-शाम ठंड का असर बढ़ने की संभावना है।
31 अक्टूबर से मौसम में सुधार के संकेत
मौसम विभाग के पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार, 31 अक्टूबर को आसमान में बादल छाए रहने के साथ हल्की बारिश या बूंदाबांदी की संभावना है।
इसके बाद 1 नवंबर को आंशिक बादल और 2 नवंबर को मुख्य रूप से साफ आसमान रहने का अनुमान है। इस दौरान अधिकतम तापमान 28 से 30 डिग्री के बीच रह सकता है।
फिलहाल, अलवर में सुबह और शाम के समय ठंड का एहसास बढ़ने लगा है। आने वाले दिनों में बारिश और तापमान में उतार-चढ़ाव के चलते मौसम का मिजाज बदल सकता है।
अलवर में वोट देने आया बुजुर्ग बेहोश हुआ: फर्जी वोटिंग की शिकायत हुई; ईवीएम खराब होने से डेढ घंटे रुका मतदान
बानसूर में 71.84 प्रतिशत मतदान हुआ: व्हीलचेयर पर आई बुजुर्ग मतदाता, जिला परिषद-पंचायत समिति सदस्यों के लिए डाले गए वोट
अलवर में गोशाला में युवक की मौत,चोट के निशान मिले: भाई बोला- पीट-पीटकर मार डाला; डेढ़ साल पहले काम करने आया था
अलवर में दूसरे चरण का मतदान कल: 109 पंचायत समिति व 20 जिला परिषद सदस्य के लिए होगा चुनाव, आज रवाना होंगी पोलिंग पार्टियां

यूपी मौसम
उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम बदलने वाला है. 29-30 अक्टूबर को पूर्वी यूपी में भारी बारिश और वज्रपात का अलर्ट जारी. पश्चिमी यूपी में हल्की वर्षा. ठंड बढ़ेगी.
UP Weather Forecast: उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम एक बार फिर करवट लेने वाला है. मौसम विभाग लखनऊ के अनुसार 29 और 30 अक्टूबर को पूर्वी यूपी के कई जिलों में भारी बारिश और वज्रपात की आशंका है. वहीं, पश्चिमी यूपी में कुछ स्थानों पर हल्की बारिश हो सकती है. मौसम विभाग ने खराब मौसम को देखते हुए येलो और ऑरेंज अलर्ट जारी किया है. इसके साथ ही प्रदेश में सुबह और रात के तापमान में गिरावट से ठंड बढ़ने के आसार हैं.
उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम का नया मिजाज और वर्षा का पूर्वानुमान
उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य में मौसम ने एक बार फिर से अपनी करवट बदली है. मौसम विभाग लखनऊ की ओर से जारी रिपोर्ट के अनुसार आने वाले दो दिनों में कई जिलों में बारिश होने की संभावना जताई जा रही है. पहले दिन कुछ चुनिंदा स्थानों पर हल्की बौछारें पड़ सकती हैं, जबकि दूसरे दिन बारिश का दायरा बढ़ने की उम्मीद है. किसान भाई अपनी फसलों को लेकर सतर्क हो गए हैं. इस बदलाव से तापमान में भी गिरावट दर्ज की जाएगी, जिससे लोगों को उमस भरी गर्मी से राहत मिलने की पूरी उम्मीद है.
पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश में भारी बारिश और वज्रपात की चेतावनी
प्रादेशिक मौसम केंद्र लखनऊ के पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम का मिजाज काफी आक्रामक रहने की पूरी संभावना जताई गई है. आगामी 29 से 30 अक्टूबर 2026 के दौरान इस क्षेत्र के कई जिलों में भारी से बहुत भारी बारिश होने की आशंका है, जिसके चलते मौसम विभाग द्वारा येलो और ओरेंज अलर्ट जारी किए गए हैं. अधिकांश स्थानों पर गरज-चमक के साथ आकाशीय बिजली गिरने और तेज झोंकेदार हवाएं चलने से आम जनजीवन प्रभावित हो सकता है.
पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश में हल्की वर्षा और तेज हवाओं के आसार
इसके विपरीत पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश के जिलों में मौसम अपेक्षाकृत कम गंभीर रहने का अनुमान व्यक्त किया गया है. पहले दिन 28 से 29 अक्टूबर के दौरान कुछ चुनिंदा स्थानों पर छिटपुट से हल्की बौछारें पड़ने और गरज के साथ हल्की हवाएं चलने की संभावना है. हालांकि, दूसरे दिन कुछ उत्तरी हिस्सों में भी बाद की आवाजाही और हल्की वर्षा हो सकती है, जिससे तापमान में हल्की गिरावट दर्ज की जाएगी और लोगों को ठंडक का अहसास होगा.
उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम का हाल और तापमान की स्थिति
उत्तर प्रदेश में पिछले चौबीस घंटों के दौरान मौसम का मिजाज काफी दिलचस्प रहा है. मौसम विभाग लखनऊ के आंकड़ों के मुताबिक राज्य के विभिन्न जिलों में तापमान में बदलाव दर्ज किया गया है. लोगों को अब धीरे-धीरे हल्की ठंड का अहसास होने लगा है. सुबह और शाम के समय तापमान में गिरावट देखने को मिल रही है, जिससे मौसम सुहाना हो गया है. किसान और आम नागरिक इस बदलाव को महसूस कर रहे हैं और आने वाले दिनों में सर्दी और बढ़ने की पूरी संभावना है.
सबसे कम तापमान और न्यूनतम तापमान वाले जिले
राज्य में पिछले चौबीस घंटों के दौरान सबसे कम न्यूनतम तापमान मुजफ्फरनगर में 14.2 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया है. इसके अलावा मेरठ में 14.9 डिग्री, नजीबाबाद में 15.0 डिग्री, हरदोई में 15.0 डिग्री और बरेली में 15.1 डिग्री सेल्सियस तापमान रिकॉर्ड किया गया है. इन आंकड़ों से साफ पता चलता है कि पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश के इन इलाकों में रात और सुबह के वक्त ठंड काफी बढ़ चुकी है. इन शहरों में तापमान सामान्य के आसपास या उससे थोड़ा नीचे चल रहा है.
सबसे अधिक तापमान और गर्म इलाके
एक तरफ जहां न्यूनतम तापमान गिर रहा है, वहीं दिन के समय धूप निकलने के कारण कुछ जिलों में अधिकतम तापमान अधिक दर्ज हुआ है. पिछले चौबीस घंटों में बहराइच राज्य का सबसे गर्म इलाका रहा, जहां अधिकतम तापमान 34.4 डिग्री सेल्सियस रिकॉर्ड किया गया. इसके अलावा बस्ती में 34.0 डिग्री, प्रयागराज में 33.8 डिग्री, लखनऊ में 33.5 डिग्री और बांदा में 33.2 डिग्री सेल्सियस अधिकतम तापमान दर्ज हुआ है. दिन में हल्की गर्मी बनी हुई है, जिससे दिन और रात के तापमान में अंतर स्पष्ट दिखाई दे रहा है.
अगले दो दिनों का मौसम और चेतावनी के मुख्य बिंदु
मौसम विभाग ने राज्य के विभिन्न हिस्सों के लिए सतर्क रहने की चेतावनी जारी की है. पहले दिन अधिकांश क्षेत्रों में स्थिति सामान्य रहने की उम्मीद है, लेकिन कुछ दक्षिणी और उत्तरी इलाकों में हल्की बारिश हो सकती है. वहीं दूसरे दिन कई जिलों में तेज हवाओं के साथ बारिश होने का अनुमान है, जिसके लिए पीला और नारंगी अलर्ट भी जारी किया गया है. लोगों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे खराब मौसम के दौरान सुरक्षित स्थानों पर रहें और अनावश्यक रूप से बाहर निकलने से बचें ताकि किसी भी प्रकार की परेशानी से बचा जा सके.

articles.title: Oracle HeatWave ML fuses machine learning with database - TechTarget

articles.full_text:
Oracle today released new machine learning integrations with its MySQL HeatWave cloud service.
The tech giant originally launched the MySQL HeatWave service in December 2020 as the Oracle MySQL Database Service with MySQL Analytics Engine. The company rebranded it as HeatWave in 2021.
The service runs the MySQL database as a managed offering on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and enables users to run both online transaction processing (OLTP) and OLAP workloads. Oracle has steadily added new features to the HeatWave platform, including automation features the company branded as "Autopilot" in Aug. 2021.
As part of the new update, generally available now, Oracle integrated machine learning (ML) capabilities into the MySQL HeatWave platform. With HeatWave ML, users can directly run ML workloads on the database service.
The MySQL HeatWave platform contains many "elegant" capabilities, said Holger Mueller, an analyst at Constellation Research.
The ability to support both OLTP and OLAP data workloads is one such set of capabilities, and Mueller noted that Oracle has expanded that by adding machine learning inside the MySQL HeatWave database service.
Customer feedback first led to the release of the MySQL Autopilot features in 2021 and has now led to the integration of machine learning with HeatWave ML, said Nipun Agarwal, senior vice president, MySQL HeatWave development at Oracle.
With the introduction of HeatWave, customers are now storing more data into the MySQL database; and for many of these customers, they need to run machine learning on this data.
Nipun Agarwal
Senior vice president, MySQL HeatWave development at Oracle
"With the introduction of HeatWave, customers are now storing more data into the MySQL database; and for many of these customers, they need to run machine learning on their data," Agarwal said.
He explained that without HeatWave ML, users had to first extract data out of MySQL into a machine learning-capable platform to run ML training or inference workloads. That's no longer the case, due to the HeatWave ML capability.
HeatWave ML uses AutoML technology that is already supported in the Oracle Autonomous Database platform.
With Oracle's AutoML, users can build out machine learning pipelines. The ML technology is now stored inside the MySQL database and the machine learning processing is also executed directly within the database.
By handling machine learning operations within the database, Agarwal said users deal with less complexity for users, as they don't need to export data.
There are also security benefits to handling machine learning inside the database, as the access controls for the MySQL database still apply. By contrast, when the data had to be exported into a separate ML tool, users needed to set up and configure access control again.
In addition to the HeatWave ML capabilities, Oracle is added new real-time elasticity and data processing improvements.
The MySQL HeatWave service runs on OCI, which can scale resources up or down as demand warrants. Agarwal explained that the new real-time elasticity feature in MySQL HeatWave will enable database deployments to scale up with new database nodes when needed without interrupting a running workload.
"The infrastructure enables the elasticity, but if we don't do anything at our layer, the queries will get interrupted when the cluster makes the transition and add a node," Agarwal said. "So that's the work we have done."
Oracle also increased the amount of data that can be processed per database node, boosting processing capability from approximately 400 gigabytes (GB) of data per node to 820 GB with a memory optimization approach known as a Bloom Filter.
The vendor also added support for the open source LZ4 compression algorithm, which further optimizes data in a MySQL HeatWave node.
"What we have done is [that] we have doubled the amount of data that can be processed per node," Agarwal said.

CHENNAI: A newborn died at the Stanley Medical College Hospital on October 24 after her 19-year-old mother allegedly attempted to flush her down a toilet at a private clinic in Tiruvottiyur. Police are discussing altering the case to include murder charges after the postmortem report revealed injuries on the infant’s body.
Tiruvottiyur police sources said the young woman, a resident of Ennore who had completed Class XII and was unmarried, was admitted to the clinic on October 24 for labour pain. Though her parents knew about her pregnancy, none of them accompanied her to the hospital, police said.
Preliminary inquiry revealed that she had been in a relationship with a lorry driver from Ennore for four years. However, after she became pregnant, he allegedly refused to marry her and married another woman, police said.
At the hospital, the woman complained of diarrhoea and was allowed to use the restroom. After spending nearly two hours inside, she delivered a baby girl and allegedly attempted to flush the newborn down the toilet, police said. When she failed to come out for a long time, hospital staff grew suspicious, knocked on the door and subsequently opened it, discovering the newborn.
Both the woman and the baby were shifted to Stanley Hospital for treatment. However, the newborn died a few hours later, and the body was sent for postmortem.
Following information from the hospital, Tiruvottiyur police initially registered a case under sections of BNS on October 24. The postmortem report received on Tuesday confirmed injuries on the infant’s body. The woman remains under treatment and has not been arrested.

Waa kuma Jeneraalkan seddexda jeer ka badbaaday dhimashada ee mar ka mid ahaa askartii Soomaaliya loo diray
Tan iyo markii uu galay saxaraha sannadkii 1971-kii, wuxuu ka soo kacay darajada askari lugta ah ilaa uu noqdo taliye guuto (ama qayb ciidan). In ka badan saddex jeer ayuu la kulmay shilal naftiisa halis gelinayay.
Jeneraal Yohannes oo loo yaqaanay John Medid wuxuu ahaa taliyaha guud ee ciidamada jiidda dhexe, ilaa uu hawlgab noqday sannadkii 2010-kii, xilligaas oo ku beegnayd markii Abiy Axmed uu xukunka qabtay.
Wuxuu hoggaamiyay ciidamada Tigrayga isagoo ah taliyaha guud, wuxuuna ka qayb galay dagaalladii koowaad iyo labaad ee Tigrayga, ilaa maalintii uu isku dhiibay ciidanka Itoobiya.
Marka loo eego xaaladihii waqtigaas jiray, John Medid oo ku dhashay kuna barbaaray miyiga, sanadkii 1954-kii, degmada Adet-Nader ee aagga Aksum ma helin wax fursado waxbarasho ah ka hor inta uusan u dhaqaaqin dhanka duurka.
Wareysi uu bixiyay ayuu ku yiri, "Waalidkay waxay ku nool yihiin miyiga, waana beeraley."
Wuxuu ahaa cunugii lixaad ee ka mid ahaa lix gabdhood iyo lix wiil, kuwaas oo wadartoodu ahayd 12 carruur ah.
John Medid, oo markii hore isku dayay inuu ku biiro ururka TPLF, ayaa loo sheegay inuu weli carruur yahay, waxaana lagu celiyay gurigiisii.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sannadkii 1978, wuxuu la kulmay oo ku biiray dagaalyahannada TPLF intii lagu jiray dagaalkii ka dhacay miyiga Aksum, dhowr bilood ka dibna wuxuu galay tababar joogto ah.
Waxaa lagu tababaray xarun tababar oo ku taal magaaladayda, Adi Zeba, halkaas oo ay ka qaybgaleen tiro badan oo dhallinyaro reer miyi ah.
Barnaamijka tababarka waxaa loogu yeeray tababar soo-bandhigid sababtoo ah waxaa jiray xubno laga soo diray Dergiga oo si wadajir ah u tababarayay ugu dambayntiina la soo bandhigay, sida uu u sheegay VOA.
Dagaalka Lenta
Taariikh-nololeedkiisu wuxuu tilmaamayaa in markii uu u baxay dhanka lama-degaanka ay jireen saddex guuto oo ka tirsan TPLF, isagana waxaa loo qoondeeyay Guutada 80-aad oo uu hoggaaminayay Samora Yenus.
Wuxuu markii ugu horreysay ka qayb galay dagaalkii ka dhacay Adi Hagerai [Sheraro].
Wuxuu xasuustaa in intii lagu guda jiray hawlgalladii billowday bishii Maarso, ay dagaalyahannadu la kulmeen harraad daran; isaguna wuu lumay, wuxuuna ku dhacay xaalad adag dagaalkaas ugu horreeyay.
"Waxa ugu weynaa ee aan la kulmay wuxuu ahaa harraad; waxay ahayd markii iigu horreysay, xaaladduna aad bay u adkayd xitaa kuwa goobta ku haray.
"Waxaa jiray allabari badan; qaarkood waxay cabbeen kaadidooda, halka kuwo kalena ay u dhinteen harraad."
Maalintii dagaalku dhacay waxaa la dilay taliyihii ugu horreeyay ee Guutada Walta [G/Medhin], waxaana sidoo kale dhaawac rasaaseed soo gaaray Jeneraal Samora Yunus, kaas oo markii dambe noqday Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Difaaca.
Asmelash W/Slassie (Abay Nebso), oo ahaa xubin hore oo ka tirsanaa hoggaanka sare ee TPLF, kaas oo lagu dilay dagaalkii Tigray [2020], ayaa sidoo kale waayay labadiisa indhood.
Markii uu noqday qofka kaliya ee badbaaday
John Medid wuxuu xasuustaa dhacdo uu ku sugnaa waajibaad ilaalo ah, balse la illoobay.
"Waxaan hayay xog sheegaysa inaan u guurayno meel kale; markii ay saaxiibaday baxeen, waxaan ogaaday in la i illoobay oo aan keligay hadhay. Ma garanayn meel ay aadeen, waxaana keligay ku dhex hadhay dhinaca cadowga."
Intaas ka dib, waxaa la diray koox hawlgal ka fulisa dhinaca cadowga xilliga habeenkii.
Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in dagaalkii ka dhacay aagga loo yaqaan 'Turn Your Face Away' uu geliyay xaalad halis ah.
Wuxuu xasuustaa in ciidamo badan oo ka tirsan Dergiga ay yimaadeen oo ay rasaas ku fureen.
"Xabbaddii ugu horreysay ayaa i haleeshay, qof ayaa i taageeray, dib ayaana la ii qaaday. Markii aan gaaray tuulo, dhiig ayaa iga baxayay, wiilkii i taageerayna wuu iska tagay."
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, markii la geeyay qaybta caafimaadka, wuxuu ogaaday in dhammaan xubnihii cutubkaas la dilay, oo uu ku jiro Dr. Ataklti Ketsela, kaas oo hoggaaminayay dagaalka, isla markaana daweeyay isaga.
Isagoo ilmo ka buuxdo indhihiisa, wuxuu sheegay inay taasi tahay xasuus murugo leh oo weligeed ku jirta noloshiisa.
Intii lagu guda jiray halganka, waxaa marar badan la diiwaangeliyay inuu jiray iskaashi militari oo xooggan oo u dhexeeyay TPLF iyo ELF.
Mid ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaashii hore ee TPLF, oo hoggaaminayay cutubyo loo diray Eritrea, wuxuu ahaa Yohannes.
Intii lagu jiray ololihii 'Xiddigta Cas' (Red Star campaign), wuxuu hoggaaminayay laba kooxood oo ka tirsan guutooyinkii loo diray jiidaha dagaalka ee Sahel.
Waxaan si gaar ah u xasuustaa dagaalkii ka dhacay jiidda Naqfa. Iyagoo sugaya, ciidanka Dergiga ayaa yimid oo si lama filaan ah u soo weeraray.
John Medid wuxuu xasuustaa in laba guuto — guutada 43-aad iyo tan 60-aad — ay goobtaas joogeen, ayna si adag u dagaallameen.
Wuxuu xusay in ololahaas, oo qaatay saddex bilood, uu sababay in goobtaas loogu bixiyo magaca 'Dambas' (Ashes), maadaama dagaallada iyo duqeymaha diyaaradaha ay wax walba u rogeen boor iyo dambas.
Ilaa maanta, goobtaas muhiimka ah waxaa loogu yeeraa magacaas.
Wuxuu xasuustaa in ciidanka Dergigu ay soo hormareen oo ay la wareegeen aagga, isaguna uu ku badbaaday god dhulka hoostiisa ah.
"Waxaan diyaar u ahayn inaan dhimanno. Waxaan naftayda ku qanciyay inaanan oggolaan in xeryaha la burburiyo annaga dartay. Waxaan ku jiray god yar, anigoo ridaya rasaas ilaa ay na dilaan mooyee."
"Markii aan qoryaha darandooriga u dhaca (machine guns) ku furnay koox cadaw ah, ma aysan fahmin meesha rasaastu ka timid, wayna kala firxadeen. Annaga laf ahaanteennu ma rumaysan karin, laakiin waan ka soo baxnay annagoo nool."
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu xasuustaa dhacdo ay dad badan dhegahoodu ka xumaadeen (dhago-beel ku yimid) sababo la xiriira dhawaaqa diyaaradaha dagaalka.
"Dagaalkii Eritrea waxaa ku baxay allabari aad u badan," ayuu yiri Medid, "ilaa haddana ma rumaysan karo inaan si dhab ah uga badbaaday."
"Waxaan ku barannay dagaalka dhaqdhaqaaqa badan (mobile warfare); xeeladda aan halkaas ku dagaallamaynayna waxay ahayd mid ku saleysan weerar-gaadmo. Aad bay noogu adkayd."
Ka soo billow dagaal khiyaano ah ilaa iyo ubucda waddanka
Intii uu socday Hawlgalka Agazi, John Medid ayaa hoggaaminayay dagaalkii khiyaanada lahaa ee ka dhacay aagga Wejerat si ay ciidanka Dergiga uga saaraan Mekelle.
Hawlgalka uu qorsheeyay Jeneraal Hailemariam waa mid ka mid ah hawlgalladii ugu guulaha badnaa ee TPLF, isagoo maxaabiis badan ka xoreeyay 'xabsiga' Mekelle.
Markii uu u socday bartamaha dalka, guutadiisii waxay ka qayb qaadatay dagaallo dhex maray Dejena [Ras Dashen] si ay ula wareegaan Nefas Mewcha iyo Guna ugu dambayntiina Debre Tabor [ee Gobolka Amxaarada]
"Wuxuu hoggaaminayay dagaal saddex bilood socday oo ka dhacay Kmr Dingay.
Waqtigaas, waxaa jiray riixitaan badan, Medid-na wuxuu sheegay in isaga laftiisa la qabtay isagoo la socda Tegalay Amorra.
"Waxaa la i qabtay gorgor waana baxsaday.
Amorra waxaa la iga codsaday inuu sir shaaciyo oo uu ka sheego inuu soo rujuucay warbaahinta dowladda.
Ka dib dhicitaanka nidaamkii Dergiga
John Medid wuxuu ka dagaallamay jiidda Bure, isagoo ahaa [ku-xigeenka koowaad] ka dibna noqday taliyaha guud ee Guutada 14-aad intii lagu jiray dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Eratareeya. Halkaas markuu ka yimid, sannadkii 2003-dii, wuxuu noqday Ku-xigeenka Taliyaha Jiidda Waqooyiga.
Intii u dhaxaysay 2003 ilaa 2005, waxaa loo diray Soomaaliya si uu u noqdo isku-duwaha qaybaha ciidamada Itoobiya.
Markii uu ka soo laabtay Soomaaliya, wuxuu beddelay Jeneraal Abebaw Tadesse isagoo noqday taliyaha guud ee Jiidda Dhexe, taas oo dhacday geeridii ka dib ee Ra'iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Itoobiya, Meles Zenawi.
Markii Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed uu xilka qabtay sannadkii 2010-kii, Jeneraal Yohannes wuxuu galay hawlgab.
Jeneraal John Medid wuxuu ka mid ahaa taliyayaashii u tagay magaalada Mekelle si ay u soo abaabulaan ciidamada Tigrayga ka hor inta uusan qarxin dagaalkii Tigrayga sannadkii 2020 kii; waxaa la sheegaa inuu isagu ahaa aasaasihii "Ciidanka Labaad" (Army Two).
Dabayaaqadii, John Medid wuxuu ahaa taliyaha Jiidda Koonfureed, taas oo ka koobnayd shan ciidan oo kala ah: Ciidanka 24-aad [oo fadhigoodu ahaa Alamata, 26-aad [Samre], 22-aad [Mekelle], 44-aad [Adi Gudem] iyo 43-aad [Mekoni].
Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegaa in isaga iyo Jeneraal Teklay Ashebir ay hoggaaminayeen Dagaalkii Workedino [oo loo yaqaanay Ololaha Alula], kaas oo loo arko inay ahaa bar-rogasho muhiim ah oo ku timid dagaalkii Tigrayga.
Taariikhdu markay ahayd 19-kii Sebtembar 2021-kii, wuxuu ka mid ahaa shan sarkaal oo sarsare oo ka soo muuqday warbaahinta, kuwaas oo sheegtay inay yihiin askar ka tirsan TPLF.
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka mid ahaa saraakiisha ugu sarreeya ee go'aamiyay in la kala diro Maamulka Kumeel-gaarka ah ee Tigrayga, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayay Getachew Reda, ka dib markii dagaalku ku dhammaaday Heshiiskii Pretoria.
Hadalladiisii ahaa, "Haddii ay qaadato 50 sano, 60 sano, ama 100 sano, waa in jiil dhan loo huraa dhimasho" ayaa dad badan si gaar ah uga xanaajiyay.
Ka dib markii dagaalku dib u qarxay 13-kii Sebtembar 2026, ciidamada Tigrayga ayaa si dhakhso ah loogu riixay xadka dalka Eratareeya. Weli lama oga in is-dhiibitaanka Jeneraal Yohannes uu saameyn xun ku yeelan doono dagaalyahannada TPLF, kuwaas oo sheegaya inay isu diyaarinayaan inay weerar kale ku qaadaan ciidamada dowladda iyo xulafadooda.
Maxaa loogu bixiyey 'Medid'
"Dabeecad ahaan, welwelka igu jira kama muuqdo wejigayga si cad," ayuu yiri Jeneraal John Medid, isagoo ka hadlaya taliyihiisii.
Wuxuu xasuustaa Jeneraal Samora Yunus oo ku yiri, "Maxaad samaynaysaa, Medid? Wejigaaga wax dareen ah kama muuqdaan."
'Medid' waa qalab dhaqameed ay hooyooyinka ku nool miyiga Tigray u isticmaalaan karinta badarka.
Laga soo bilaabo maalintaas, magaca 'Medid' ayaa ku dhegay, saaxiibadiisii ay wada dagaallamayeenna waxay si weyn ugu yaqaaniin naanaystan.
Jeneraal John Medid, afar ka mid ah shan walaalihiis ah oo iyaguna galay duurka, ayaa ku dhintay duurkaas.
Waa aabbe dhalay afar carruur ah.

articles.title: Construction projects face the challenge of extreme heat. - Vietnam.vn
articles.search_term: (heatwave OR "heat wave" OR "severe heatwave" OR "extreme heat" OR "heat spell" OR "scorching heat" OR "blistering heat" OR "sweltering heat" OR "hot winds" OR loo OR "hot loo winds" OR "intense heat" OR "unbearable heat" OR "deadly heat" OR heat OR "weather forecast" OR "weather update" OR "weather alert" OR "IMD forecast" OR "IMD prediction" OR "IMD alert" OR IMD OR "rising temperatures" OR "temperatures expected to rise" OR "relief from heat" OR "respite from heat" OR "heat respite" OR "respite from scorching heat") Andaman and Nicobar Islands
articles.full_text:
Refine the standards and expand heat resistance capabilities.
In 2026, from March to July, Northern Vietnam recorded 9 widespread heatwaves, exceeding the number of heatwaves in all of 2025. The average number of hot days reached approximately 35; Hanoi alone recorded 40 days. Many weather stations recorded record-breaking high temperatures. This reality shows that heatwaves are no longer just a weather issue but are becoming a challenge to the design, construction, and operation of infrastructure.
When outdoor temperatures rise, roof surfaces, walls, and window systems can absorb and transfer heat into the interior space, increasing the need for air conditioning. This not only affects the comfort and health of users but also increases electricity costs and puts pressure on the energy supply system. Therefore, heat resistance should be considered from the design stage, rather than only addressing the problem after the building is in use.
According to Vu Van Dung, Deputy Director of the Institute of Building Materials, Ministry of Construction , Vietnam has had regulations related to energy efficiency in buildings for quite some time, starting about 20 years ago (beginning in 2005 with Standard TCXDVN 09:2005, then replaced by TCVN 17:2017, and currently QCVN 04:2016 along with Circular No. 61).
However, according to Mr. Vu Van Dung, the scope of current regulations is still limited and does not fully cover buildings that do not use air conditioning or extreme weather conditions. This is a gap that needs to be studied and addressed if we want to improve the thermal resilience of buildings on a large scale.
The completion of the system of standards and regulations requires a roadmap, based on scientific data and the specific climatic conditions of Vietnam. Regulations on climate zones used in construction are an important basis for selecting design solutions, calculating thermal insulation capabilities, and saving energy suitable for each area. In addition, the TCVN 5687:2024 standard on ventilation and air conditioning also provides a reference for designing indoor thermal conditions.
Nevertheless, current regulations still need to be reviewed to better adapt to extreme heat waves and climate change scenarios. Temperature thresholds established under normal conditions may no longer be appropriate when outdoor temperatures remain high for extended periods. Children, the elderly, and those with underlying health conditions may be particularly vulnerable if indoor environments do not maintain suitable temperatures.
You may also like
According to Mr. Dung, this issue is not solely within the purview of the construction industry but requires coordination from multiple sectors, including education and healthcare, to determine appropriate requirements for spaces with specific uses. For example, schools, healthcare facilities, and buildings serving vulnerable groups should be considered based on actual usage needs, rather than applying a single general threshold.
Along with expanding the scope of standards, cost considerations also need to be taken into account. Initial investment costs for insulation materials, shading systems, and engineering solutions may increase, but with proper design, the building can reduce cooling needs and save on operating costs in the long term. Therefore, efficiency assessments should consider the entire lifecycle of the building, rather than just comparing initial construction costs.
Passive design, a solution derived from traditional architecture.
From an architectural perspective, Associate Professor Dr. Architect Le Thi Hong Na, lecturer at the University of Technology, Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City, believes that heat resistance is a crucial issue for construction projects in Vietnam, a country located in a hot and humid tropical climate. Experience from traditional architecture shows that our ancestors knew how to utilize natural conditions to improve the living environment without relying heavily on mechanical equipment.
Solutions such as site selection, building design, orientation, spatial arrangement, shading, insulation, and natural ventilation all fall under the category of passive design. When considered in conjunction with other measures, these solutions help limit solar radiation, improve air circulation, and reduce heat buildup inside the building.
According to Associate Professor, Dr. Architect Le Thi Hong Na, in previous climates, many passive design solutions could relatively well meet the thermal comfort needs of users. However, as climate change causes temperatures to rise and heatwaves to become more severe, these solutions may no longer be sufficient at all times, especially for buildings with high occupancy rates or requiring strict thermal conditions.
Therefore, building design needs a clear order of priorities: first, exploit passive solutions to reduce heat absorption and cooling needs; then, add active solutions such as air conditioning when necessary. This approach aims to ensure user comfort while contributing to reduced energy consumption and minimizing environmental impact.
In reality, effective heat insulation doesn't depend on a single material but is the result of a combination of many factors. The roof and walls need to be constructed appropriately; windows need to be considered for their heat transfer and solar radiation absorption capabilities; shading, ventilation, and spatial organization must be suitable for the building's orientation and local climate conditions. Simply adding cooling equipment without addressing the underlying causes of heat entry into the building can lead to continued increases in electricity consumption.
You may also like
Besides design solutions, evaluating the practical effectiveness after a building is put into operation is also crucial. According to Mr. Vu Van Dung, the new regulations require reporting data on thermal performance and energy efficiency after 12 months of operation for buildings within the scope of regulation. This data, along with user feedback and actual electricity costs, can provide a basis for assessing the building's compliance, thereby further improving the system of standards and regulations.
For effective implementation, it is necessary to standardize criteria, testing methods, and evaluation methods, while developing laboratory systems, databases, and technical consulting capabilities. Reporting mechanisms also need to be rationally designed, avoiding unnecessary administrative procedures for investors and the public.
The Institute of Building Materials is researching and drafting regulations on energy labeling for several groups of building materials, aiming to provide clearer information on the thermal properties and energy efficiency of products. According to Mr. Dung, finalizing these regulations needs to be linked to a suitable roadmap, because applying minimum thermal requirements on a large scale by 2030 still faces many challenges regarding climate data, technical infrastructure, and the level of completeness of the standards system.
Faced with increasing heat stress, the need arises not only for supplementing regulations but also for changing the approach to building design and use. When heat resistance is considered from the outset, passive architectural solutions are prioritized, and operational efficiency is monitored using real-world data, buildings will have a better chance of maintaining comfortable living conditions, reducing energy costs, and improving their adaptability to climate change.

articles.title: Delhi-NCR Weather Alert: Rain and Strong Winds Expected - Urban Acres
articles.search_term: ("mercury soars" OR "mercury crosses" OR "temperature soars" OR "record temperature" OR "all-time high" OR "degrees Celsius" OR "maximum temperature" OR "hottest day" OR "temperature crosses 40" OR "temperature crosses 45" OR "temperature likely to rise") Andaman and Nicobar Islands
articles.full_text:
Delhi-NCR may see rain accompanied by strong winds on Thursday and Friday as a reported cyclone over the Bay of Bengal moves inland and weakens, according to a report by Live Hindustan – NCR citing the weather department’s forecast. The system is also expected to bring a fall in both daytime and night-time temperatures across the capital region.
The report said the cyclone, identified as ‘Arnab’, began reaching the Andhra Pradesh coast on Wednesday. It is expected to weaken while moving across Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and Nepal. The system’s movement could influence weather conditions in Delhi and surrounding areas, with moisture and a change in wind direction contributing to the possibility of light rain in parts of the capital.
The expected shift comes as Delhi’s weather has already begun to cool. The minimum temperature recorded at the Safdarjung weather station was 15.3 degrees Celsius on Tuesday, according to the report. This was 1.9 degrees Celsius above normal, but represented a decline of three degrees over the previous three days. The maximum temperature was 31.5 degrees Celsius, or 0.1 degrees above normal.
At Pusa, the minimum temperature was recorded at 14.7 degrees Celsius. Humidity at Safdarjung ranged from 42% to 94%, indicating substantial variation through the day. The figures reflect the transition from the warmer conditions recorded in Delhi roughly a week earlier, when strong sunshine had kept daytime weather relatively hot.
The report attributed the expected weather change partly to a shift in wind direction towards the north and north-east. Moisture carried by the stronger winds may lead to light rainfall at several locations. For residents, the combination of rain, wind and lower temperatures could affect morning and evening travel, outdoor work and routine movement, although the supplied report does not provide a specific disruption advisory for roads, public transport or schools.
The weather department’s forecast cited in the report placed Wednesday’s maximum temperature between 29 and 31 degrees Celsius and the minimum between 15 and 17 degrees Celsius. Skies were expected to remain partly cloudy during the day, with north-easterly winds dominating.
The immediate urban concern is the speed at which weather conditions may change across the region. Delhi’s roads, footpaths and outdoor public spaces are used intensively throughout the day, while construction and roadside activity remain exposed to wind and rain. However, the supplied report does not specify rainfall quantities, wind-speed thresholds, colour-coded warnings or instructions for municipal agencies.
Residents and city agencies will need to follow subsequent official weather updates for more precise information on rainfall intensity, wind conditions and any local advisories. The next forecast updates will clarify whether the expected rain remains light and localised or develops into a broader weather disruption across Delhi-NCR.

Cyclone Landfall Underway In Andhra Pradesh, Heavy Rain Hits Coast As Relief Measures Intensify
The landfall process of the cyclone is currently underway along the coastal regions of Andhra Pradesh and is expected to continue for two to three hours. Strong gusty winds and heavy rainfall have been reported in the affected areas. Preemptive power cuts remain in place across the landfall zones to prevent untoward incidents, with power to be restored once safety clearances are granted. Administrative authorities and field officers are focused primarily on rescue and relief operations, assessing potential damage to lives and livestock. The state machinery is actively monitoring the situation to shift affected individuals to medical centres or rehabilitation camps, working towards ensuring zero loss of life.

articles.title: Gadchiroli Orange Alert Warns of Heavy Rain, Lightning Today - Urban Acres
articles.search_term: ("heat advisory" OR "heat action plan" OR "heat alert" OR "IMD warning" OR "IMD alert" OR "red alert" OR "orange alert" OR "yellow alert" OR "NDMA advisory" OR "cooling shelter" OR "relief measures" OR "heat compensation" OR "severe weather warning") Andaman and Nicobar Islands
articles.full_text:
The Regional Meteorological Centre, Nagpur, has issued an orange alert for Gadchiroli district on October 28, warning of heavy to very heavy rain, thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds of 40-50 kmph. The district disaster management authority has asked residents, farmers and government departments to take precautions.
The authority said moderate to heavy rainfall is expected at most places in Gadchiroli on October 29, with isolated instances of heavy rain, lightning and gusty winds. Light to moderate rain is likely at isolated locations on October 30.
Residents have been advised to avoid venturing outdoors during thunderstorms and to seek shelter inside safe buildings. The disaster management authority cautioned people against standing under tall trees, near electric poles or metal structures, and inside temporary sheds during severe weather.
People have also been asked to stay away from water bodies, metal objects and electrical appliances during lightning. The precautions are particularly relevant in exposed outdoor areas and for communities whose daily activities depend on farming and local travel.
Farmers have been advised to plan agricultural activities according to weather forecasts and official advisories. Residents have been asked to monitor updates from the administration and follow instructions issued by local authorities.
The district disaster management authority has directed all concerned departments to take necessary precautionary measures. Residents requiring emergency assistance have been asked to contact the district control room.

An orange alert has been issued for Gadchiroli on October 28 as the Regional Meteorological Centre in Nagpur forecasts heavy to very heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, lightning and winds of 40-50 kmph across the district.
The district disaster management authority has urged residents and farmers to remain vigilant and take precautions as adverse weather is expected. It has also asked government departments and other concerned agencies to make necessary preparations.
The forecast indicates moderate to heavy rainfall at most places in Gadchiroli on October 29, with isolated instances of heavy rain, lightning and gusty winds. Light to moderate rain is likely at isolated places on October 30, according to the weather advisory reported by the Times of India.
Residents have been advised to avoid venturing outdoors during thunderstorms and to take shelter inside safe buildings. The authority cautioned people against standing under tall trees, near electric poles or metal structures, and inside temporary sheds during severe weather.
The advisory also asks residents to stay away from water bodies, metal objects and electrical appliances during lightning. Farmers have been told to plan agricultural activities according to weather forecasts and official advisories, which could help reduce exposure during periods of lightning, strong winds and intense rain.
The district administration has asked people to monitor official weather updates and follow instructions issued by local authorities. For emergency assistance, residents have been directed to contact the district control room. The administration’s next steps include precautionary measures by concerned departments and continued monitoring of the forecast through the alert period.

HYDERABAD: The state government on Tuesday declared 365 mandals in 31 districts drought-affected for Kharif-2026 and directed district collectors to initiate relief measures. Of these, 111 mandals were classified as severely drought-affected and 254 as moderately drought-affected.
Nalgonda and Sangareddy (28 mandals each), Suryapet (23), Vikarabad and Adilabad (20 each), Nizamabad and Rangareddy (18 each), Yadadri and Khammam (17 each) and Bhadradri-Kothagudem (16) were among the worst-affected districts.
According to GO 3, issued by Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju, the notification will remain valid for six months unless withdrawn earlier.
District collectors, along with the directors of Agriculture, Horticulture and Animal Husbandry and the Civil Supplies Corporation, have been directed to initiate relief measures, maintain registers of beneficiaries and expenditure, and submit regular progress reports to the Revenue (Disaster Management) department.
Mandals not included in the notification will continue to be monitored by the State Drought Monitoring Cell and may be added through a supplementary notification if conditions warrant, the GO said.
Relief measures will include input subsidies through Direct Benefit Transfer, augmentation of drinking water supplies, fodder arrangements and cattle camps where required, and employment generation under VB-G RAM G.
Collectors told to approach SLBC for agri loan rescheduling
Collectors have also been directed to approach the State Level Bankers’ Committee (SLBC) for restructuring agricultural credit and preventing coercive loan recovery, wherever permissible under Reserve Bank of India guidelines.
The Agriculture department must disburse input subsidies to affected farmers through DBT within one month of receiving Central assistance from the National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF). Beneficiary lists will be published on the websites of the respective district collectors and the state government.
The Planning department will prepare a memorandum for the Revenue (DM) department to forward to the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and the Ministry of Home Affairs, seeking NDRF assistance.
The GO said automated rainfall data from OTSDPS and DES telemetry for June 1 to September 30, 2026, along with dry-spell logs, were assessed under the mandatory Trigger 1 assessment. The mandals were then evaluated against Trigger 2 impact indicators, using any three of four parameters: agriculture (crop-sown area shortfall, assessed by the Agriculture and Cooperation department), remote sensing (Vegetation Condition Index, TGRAC), soil moisture (Moisture Adequacy Index, PJTSAU) and hydrology (Groundwater Drought Index, Ground Water department).
The drought category was determined, as permitted by the manual, for mandals with more than 75% irrigated area. Ground-truthing surveys were conducted in 10% of villages in each mandal, with field verification findings serving as the final basis for determining drought intensity.
Proposals and ground-truthing survey reports submitted by district collectors, along with verified technical inputs and recommendations from the concerned departments, were scrutinised and placed before the Cabinet sub-committee.
The state received 615.5 mm of rainfall between June 1 and September 30, against the normal 740.6 mm, a deficit of 17%. Eighteen of the 33 districts recorded deficient rainfall. The Kharif crop area fell from 139.28 lakh acres to 126.06 lakh acres, while the area under paddy declined by 18%, from 69.19 lakh acres to 57 lakh acres.
Live storage in major and medium reservoirs stood at 179.63 tmcft against a combined capacity of 585 tmcft, raising concerns over drinking water supplies, agriculture, livestock and power.
The Legislative Assembly had unanimously adopted a resolution on the rainfall deficit caused by El Niño on September 18, 2026. It urged the Union government to send a Central team to assess the situation, sanction NDRF assistance and release its share of the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF). The resolution also sought support for crop-loss compensation, input subsidies, drinking water, fodder, groundwater and water-body restoration.
The state government also sought 50 additional days of employment under VB-G RAM G, with the Union government bearing the entire cost, increased fertiliser supplies, an additional 1,500 MW of power and a `20,000-crore special drought-relief package.
It further sought an increase in the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) borrowing limit from 3% to 3.5% of gross state domestic product (GSDP) for 2026-27, along with additional assistance under Central and Centrally Sponsored Schemes with relaxed norms.

Translated with AI from the Russian original.
The classic was given a fresh coat of paint, but some players still have questions about its optimization.
The “OpenCNC 3D + RDA” project was recently unveiled. It is an unofficial 3D remake of the cult strategy game Command & Conquer: Red Alert.
The project is based on the original game logic of EA’s Tiberian Dawn and Red Alert, meaning the gameplay rules are identical. The modders invite fans to check out the updated graphics and the Enhanced 3D mode — the original designs remain easily recognizable in this mode:
However, there are still significant technical issues. A player going by the nickname Gaming_Nomad conducted tests and highlighted several problems — he suspects that the project was created using AI (“vibecoding”):
- Visual effects randomly mix and switch between classic and enhanced graphics: MANPADS rockets launched by rocketeers could suddenly turn into old 2D graphics, as could certain explosion effects.
- There is a severe memory leak across all maps when using enhanced graphics, causing “FPS to drop from 120+ down to just 1 FPS in only 20 minutes of gameplay”.
Work on the 3D version of Command & Conquer: Red Alert is ongoing. The files are distributed through the OpenCNC 3D website.
